content: Anxiety (Spanish: Ansiedad) is a 1953 Mexican musical drama film directed by Miguel Zacarías and starring Pedro Infante, Libertad Lamarque and Irma Dorantes.[1] It was shot at the Churubusco Studios in Mexico City. The film's sets were designed by the art director Javier Torres Torija.
